# Eng Staff 2026-10-05

**Attendees:** Maya Chen (chair), Marcus Bell, Nadia Okafor, Devon Park, Kavi Raman, Lin Zhao, Renee Alvarez, Sam Whitfield, Sarah Kim
**Notes:** Nadia

## Agenda

1. Q4 Engineering Plan draft
2. Investing GA: Oct 20 and the three blockers
3. Sep 26 follow-ups and the Pillar remediation plan
4. Series B diligence: Elena Sorensen call Oct 14
5. SOC 2 gaps
6. Hiring: VP Eng finals this week, senior iOS offer

## Notes

**1. Q4 plan (Maya).** Draft is up (Q4 Engineering Plan). Order: investing GA, money-movement safety, Series B, SOC 2, hiring. Card build is out of Q4 (Card Issuing - Timeline Change). Locks after go/no-go #2.

**2. Investing (Renee).** GA target Oct 20 is at risk. Reconciliation fix: Devon has the PR mostly done, review this week. Disclosures: Hana Ito expects to sign Wednesday. Android: order confirmation done, performance detail in progress. Go/no-go #2 on Oct 16.

**3. Sep 26 follow-ups (Marcus).** ADR-031 - Idempotency Keys for All Money-Moving Jobs proposed today. The ADR includes an inventory of money-moving Sidekiq jobs; most have no idempotency key today. ADR-032 draft (round-up sweep onto the outbox) by Wednesday. Pillar wants the written remediation plan by Oct 15 (Pillar QBR - Q3); Maya owns, draft is Pillar Bank Remediation Plan - Sep 26 Incident.

**4. Diligence (Maya).** Elena Sorensen call Oct 14. Marcus, Devon and Sam join for parts. Data room engineering section due Oct 12. Prep page coming later this week.

**5. SOC 2 (Sam).** Q3 access review 55%. Vendor risk: DriveWealth and Lithic done (2 of 4). MDM at 95%; five laptops left, two of them are contractors.

**6. Hiring (Maya, me).** Grace Liu final round tomorrow, Tomas Reyes Thursday. TL panel for both. Ama (senior iOS) is our top candidate; her ask is above our current band. I'm writing the offer approval page today; need comp approval by Oct 10.

## Decisions

Decision: Q4 priority order is investing GA, money-movement safety, Series B, SOC 2, hiring; no new commitments until go/no-go #2 (Maya).

Decision: ADR-031 covers every job that moves money, including the legacy Sidekiq jobs we plan to retire.

Risk: Marcus owns ADR-031, the NACHA alert tuning and three items in the remediation plan, and is in the diligence call. That's too much on one person in two weeks.

Risk: Devon has the reconciliation fix (Oct 14) and the Sidekiq ACH deletion (Oct 16) back to back.

Open question: Can Sarah take ADR-032 end to end so Marcus can focus on ADR-031?

## Action items

- [ ] Devon: land position reconciliation fix by 2026-10-14
- [ ] Devon: delete Sidekiq ACH code by 2026-10-16
- [ ] Marcus: tune NACHA-cutoff alert by 2026-10-13
- [ ] Marcus: idempotency keys on all money-moving jobs by 2026-10-23
- [ ] Marcus: draft ADR-032 (round-up sweep onto the outbox pipeline) with Sarah by 2026-10-07
- [ ] Nadia: ship Android parity for the two investing screens by 2026-10-15
- [ ] Nadia: get comp approval and extend senior iOS offer to Ama by 2026-10-10
- [ ] Sam: finish Q3 access review by 2026-10-10
- [ ] Sam: get MDM coverage to 100% (with IT) by 2026-10-17
- [ ] Sam: complete remaining vendor risk assessments by 2026-10-24
- [ ] Maya: data room engineering section (architecture narrative, scale metrics, security policies, SOC 2 status letter) by 2026-10-12
- [ ] Maya: send written remediation plan to Theresa Lowe and Priya Shah by 2026-10-15
- [ ] Maya: VP Eng decision by 2026-10-20
- [x] Marcus: propose ADR-031 by 2026-10-05
